fine_lines.title: Obvs vs obviously
fine_lines.explanation_ar: obvs اختصار عامي جداً لـ obviously، يُقال بين الأصدقاء فقط. في الكتابة الرسمية أو العمل استخدم obviously.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Obvs' is a very informal short form of 'obviously'. Use it only with friends. In formal speech or writing, use 'obviously'.

examples.sentence: Of course I'm coming to your party - obvs!
Obviously, all students must bring their ID.

fine_lines.title: Yikes vs cringe
fine_lines.explanation_ar: yikes كلمة تعجّب تعبّر عن صدمة أو خوف مفاجئ. cringe تصف شيئاً يجعلك تشعر بالإحراج وعدم الارتياح.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Yikes!' shows sudden shock or worry. 'Cringe' describes something that makes you feel embarrassed and uncomfortable.

examples.sentence: His old school photos are so cringe.

fine_lines.title: Fib vs lie
fine_lines.explanation_ar: fib كذبة صغيرة غير مهمة غالباً، وهي كلمة غير رسمية. lie كلمة عامة لأي كذبة، صغيرة أو كبيرة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A fib is a small, unimportant lie (informal). 'Lie' is the general word for any untrue statement.

examples.sentence: I told a little fib - I said I liked the cake.
Telling lies to the police is a crime.

expressions.meaning_en: very informal short form of 'obvious' or 'obviously'
expressions.example: Do I want ice cream? Obvs!

expressions.meaning_en: a small lie that is not very serious; to tell one
expressions.example: He fibbed that he had finished his homework.

expressions.meaning_en: to make something a little more stylish or attractive (say /ʒʊʒ/)
expressions.example: Let's zhuzh up this plain room with some plants.

expressions.meaning_en: (of a person or thing) too much, over the top, trying too hard
expressions.example: Wearing a suit to a picnic? You're so extra!

expressions.meaning_en: approximately, more or less; can be added to words or used alone
expressions.example: Let's meet at sevenish. - Are you ready? - Ish.

expressions.meaning_en: knowing all the details about something
expressions.example: Ask Maha about the project - she's across everything.

expressions.meaning_en: an exclamation of shock or worry
expressions.example: Yikes! I left my keys inside the car.

expressions.meaning_ar: مُحرج جداً / يجعلك تتقلص من الحرج
expressions.meaning_en: (adjective, informal) very embarrassing; (verb) to feel embarrassed
expressions.example: That advert is so cringe. I cringed when I heard my recorded voice.

grammar.title: The suffix -ish
grammar.explanation_ar: نضيف ish- إلى الأرقام والأوقات والصفات لنعني 'تقريباً' أو 'إلى حد ما': sevenish (حوالي السابعة)، tallish (طويل نوعاً ما). ويمكن قول Ish وحدها كجواب يعني 'نوعاً ما'.
grammar.explanation_en: Add -ish to numbers, times and adjectives to mean 'about' or 'quite': sevenish, tallish, goodish. 'Ish' alone can be an answer meaning 'sort of'.
